workflow.description: Uses approved BR-01 and AC-01..03; maintains exclusions and uses known context before requesting more
Planning handoff into tasks and QA, task dependencies consistent with technical contract and parallel work
Unknown historical effort and allocation remain unknown; no fabricated calendar delivery

template.description: Effort in developer-days with assumptions, task reconciliation and uncertainty separated from commitment
Every implementation task has ID, dependencies, effort, verifiable acceptance
Positive, negative, authorization and direct API/backend cases with preconditions and expected side effects
BR-01 and AC-01..03 link to actual implementation and test cases

governance.description: No resend/expiry or invented behavior treated as approved
No fabricated actual effort, memory recalls, QA execution or external delivery
Draft-only, no real tracker writes or publish without user authorization
